text: The document in the sensitive folder has [file contents]. It's a formal certificate from the Chronos Guild of Temporal Explorers. The recipient is Alexander Thorne. The award is 'The Golden Gear Award' for exceptional performance in Sector Delta-7, specifically in charting unstable timeline shifts. Issued on the 12th Day of November, 2342, at the Aethelgard Temporal Archives, Sector D-7. Signed by Elara Vance and Silas Finch.
